empty: No measures yet. Add the first measure for an initiative or a project.
legend: Green at {green}% of target or more, amber at {amber}% or more, red below. Black: the figure is missing. A person marker: the figure is not verified yet. Grey: not judged yet.
streak: Periods off target in a row
unverified: Not verified yet: check this figure against its source.
missing: No figure for this period. It has to be found.
verifiedLabel: Checked against a system of record
name: Name
definitionHint: What counts, from which system, ex- or inc-VAT, invoiced or collected.
doneHint: A yes/no measure: done is green, the first miss amber, a second miss in a row red.

source.tickets_completed: Tickets completed in It's a Plan

rule.linearHint: Start, then the step added every period.
rule.compoundingHint: Start, then grows by the rate every period.
rule.gateHint: Reach the target by the date; until then the target is the pace to get there.
rule.leapfrogHint: Start, then steps up to a new level on each date.
rule.financeHint: The project's cycle targets, or the initiative's planned value in each cycle, spread over the periods by working days.
